_source: urdf_degrees = sign * scale * bus_value + offset_deg. Signs from the nudges in runs/nudge/ checked against renders in runs/urdf-map/. Offsets from holding the arm by hand in the URDF zero pose on 24 Oct (runs/urdf-map/zero-pose-joints.tsv rows 719-783: pan -24.4, lift 92.0, elbow -75.9, wrist_flex 0.9, wrist_roll 2.8, gripper 9.7 with jaws closed). The rest pose rendered with these offsets matches setup/side.png (runs/urdf-map/rest-two-offsets.png, left). Gripper scale is the motor's 138.3 degrees over its 100 percent range (so101/lerobot/cap_so101.json). Wrist_Roll's sign is the least sure: it rests on a small render and one nudge.
